props.name: defaultFen
props.description: The starting position. Defaults to the standard one.

props.name: defaultPgn
props.description: A game to load on mount instead. Wins over `defaultFen`.

props.name: defaultOrientation
props.description: Which side sits at the bottom. The Flip button changes it.

props.name: tools
props.description: Show the FEN and PGN tools under the move list.

props.name: onMove
props.description: Called after every move with the move and the FEN it produced.

props.name: onGameEnd
props.description: Called when a move ends the game.
